question: In which year did Nitu Ghanghas win India's first gold medal at the World Boxing Championships?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2023**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Nitu Ghanghas** won India’s first gold medal at the **2023 IBA Women’s World Boxing Championships**.
 
• The event was held in **New Delhi, India**, showcasing India as a significant host for global boxing events.
 
• She competed in the **48 kg minimum weight category** and delivered a stellar performance in the final match.
 
• Her opponent in the finals was **Lutsaikhan Altantsetseg** from Mongolia, whom she defeated convincingly.
 
• This victory marked her as one of India’s prominent boxing talents and added to India’s legacy in international boxing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **IBA Women’s World Boxing Championships**

 
 
• Organized by the **International Boxing Association (IBA)**, it is one of the most prestigious events in women’s boxing.
 
• Started in 2001, it is held biennially and features multiple weight categories.
 
• India has been a dominant force in this championship, with legends like **Mary Kom** winning multiple titles.
 
 
 
• **India's Contribution to Boxing**
 
 
• India has produced several world-class boxers such as **Mary Kom, Vijender Singh, Lovlina Borgohain**, and **Nikhat Zareen**.
 
• The country has hosted major international boxing events, including the Women’s World Boxing Championships in 2006 and 2023.
 
 
 
• **Weight Categories in Boxing**
 
 
• Boxing matches are divided into weight categories to ensure fairness, such as **flyweight, bantamweight, lightweight**, and more.
 
• Nitu Ghanghas competed in the **minimum weight category (48 kg)**, which is one of the lightest categories in boxing.
 
 
 
• **Role of Boxing Federations**
 
 
• The **Boxing Federation of India (BFI)** is responsible for promoting and organizing boxing events in India.
 
• It plays a crucial role in identifying and nurturing talent at the grassroots level and ensuring representation in global championships.
